flows.name: Image-backed Prime Contract SOV preview
steps: Submit a supported screenshot with Prime Contract SOV cost codes and amounts
Keep the screenshot available to a text-only follow-up in the active conversation
Resolve omitted cost type only from one exact project cost-code and amount match
Return a no-write Prime Contract SOV preview
Require the exact stored preview token and explicit user confirmation before the atomic write
flows.expectedOutcome: The assistant reads the screenshot, stays on the conversational action-tool path, and produces a safe SOV preview without guessing or making an unconfirmed write.

claims.description: Supported images are validated, forwarded to the model, and remain attachment-aware for active-conversation follow-ups.
Missing cost type resolves only from one exact active project budget-code and amount match.
Ambiguous and missing matches block, while writes retain preview-token, explicit-confirmation, permission, draft-only, audit, stale-state, and atomic RPC gates.
